purpose: Render an explicit engineering snapshot and chosen decision views; no semantic inference or approval.

views.records: Question, selected record IDs, their objects, nature, status, sources and conditions.
views.relations: Question, selected supplied relations, their explanations and sources; do not infer omitted edges.
views.cost: Question, explicit quantity and fee bases; arithmetic known subtotal and visible omitted lines.
views.changes: Question, explicitly recorded changes, reasons and affected record IDs; not an inferred impact closure.

identity: Report revision, product revision, project state, audience and evidence maturity are separate input fields.
unknown: Record unknowns explicitly. Null amount or quantity remains unknown; an incomplete subtotal is never a complete price.
authority: Use Semantica for engineering semantic execution. Rendering only checks the report transport contract and references.
source_boundary: Sources may be provided excerpts; a source title or excerpt does not imply the original attachment was inspected.
generation: Freeze the exact input, contract, preamble, rendering map and generator identity for each output.
quality: Verify frozen hashes, selected-row coverage, source bindings, arithmetic display and PDF text/layout separately from engineering semantics.
